decisions.reason: Transactional email sending builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and data centers, so it can read early results well and improve the service through its own R&D, and its home-page placement signals strategic priority.

Document capture extends the firm's electronic document workflow offer and has a dedicated page, though recognition technology is less core to its knowledge base and carries somewhat more learning risk.
Email and fax conversion rests on long-standing messaging and fax competence that lets the firm assimilate customer feedback easily and serve regulated customers who still rely on fax.
Fax delivery optimization is close to the existing offer and cheap to maintain, but as a feature it could be folded into the core fax service rather than marketed separately.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's email security line, where its existing security knowledge and R&D support ongoing improvement against fast-changing threats.
Multi-engine virus scanning fits closely with the firm's security and messaging infrastructure, though it may later be merged into broader security bundles.
